subject: Request: 3yr rate stability + uplift cap for NovaLabs (procurement ask)
messages:
From: Sophie Park <procurement@novalabs.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask — multi-year pricing & uplift cap

Hi Grace,

Following up from our call this morning — NovaLabs is evaluating Redwood for our inference platform across the next 3 years. Our procurement/finance team needs a firm pricing envelope to model forecasts and to get board sign-off. Two asks: 1) a 3-year price lock for the base consumption rate, and 2) a max annual uplift cap (we'd be comfortable with something in the single-digit percentage range).

We expect steady growth (est. 45% ARR ramp year 1→3), and the lock is a gating item for our CFO. Can Redwood provide a proposed term sheet that includes: base rate, uplift cap, renewal protection language (no unexpected step-ups on renewal), and any minimum annual commitment that would be required to secure the lock?

CCing Diego (CTO) — he wants to ensure the plan maps to expected capacity.

Thanks — looking for a written proposal by EOD Monday if possible.

Best,
Sophie Park
Procurement Manager, NovaLabs
procurement@novalabs.com

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <procurement@novalabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — multi-year pricing & uplift cap

Sophie — thanks for the clear framing and the timeline. I can get a draft over quickly; looping in Deal Desk (Marissa) and Aditya for pricing/exec alignment.

Quick note on what makes these requests non-standard: 3-year firm locks plus low uplift caps materially change our capacity and revenue recognition headroom — typically we require either a committed ARR or an uplight for volatility. That said, NovaLabs is strategic and this is doable with the right guardrails.

I'll kick off with a proposed pricing matrix (attached: pricing_model_v3.xlsx) and ask Deal Desk to enumerate the approval we need.

Next steps:
- Marissa: can you draft the ask and highlight the required approvals (discount thresholds, lock duration)?
- Aditya: any high-level constraints from the leadership side you want included?

Grace O'Connor
Senior AE — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (pricing matrix stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — multi-year pricing & uplift cap (Deal Desk recommendation)

Grace / Aditya — see Deal Desk rec below for the NovaLabs ask. I'm including proposed contractual language snippets for Legal and a summary for Execs.

Deal summary (proposed):
- Term: 36 months (three 12-month periods), effective on signature.
- Commitment: $1.8M ACV minimum commitment over 3 years (monthly invoicing).
- Base rate: $0.022 / token (volume tiers applied) — locked for 36 months subject to conditions below.
- Uplift cap: max 8% annual uplift on base rate (compounded annually).
- Renewal protection: renewal cannot increase base rate beyond the uplift cap; any add-on services priced separately.
- Early termination: customer may terminate with 90 days notice if Redwood materially breaches SLAs; otherwise early termination fee = remaining committed value * 60%.
- Discount: up to 30% discount off list at start for committed minimum (this is a non-standard concession; requires exec sign-off).

Rationale: NovaLabs is a high-growth prospect with strategic integrations; the larger commitment reduces our cost-to-serve and provides predictable utilization for the GPU pool.

Approvals requested:
1) Executive pricing exception: approve 30% discount for 36mo term (deal_id NL-2028-3456).
2) Approval to grant a 36mo price lock with 8% uplift cap.
3) Authorization to accept the proposed early-termination fee structure.

Risks & mitigations:
- Upside lost if market prices fall: require a floor in contract that allows renegotiation if our model unit costs drop >15%.
- Capacity & latency risk at high growth: include guaranteed onboarding milestones and a CS playbook; require NovaLabs to commit to quarterly consumption forecasts.

Related assets: HubSpot deal link & Exec pricing form (links below). I attached the price grid (pricing_model_v3.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW-draft.pdf) for scope. Legal to add precise clause wording for renewal protection and the 'market repricing' escape.

Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, pricing_model_v3.xlsx
Related: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/NL-2028-3456

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Initial ask — multi-year pricing & uplift cap (Escalation to Exec)

Laura — forwarding Deal Desk rec for NovaLabs. TL;DR: strategic prospect, asking for 3yr price lock and a 30% discount tied to a $1.8M committed ARR over 3 years + uplift cap 8%/yr.

Key points for Exec review:
- Revenue profile: $1.8M committed (good near-term revenue).
- Margin impact: with 30% discount and expected utilization the first 12 months, contribution margin remains positive but low — accept only with the following conditions:
  * cap uplift to 7% (vs 8% proposed) to protect revenue if costs rise;
  * include a 15% gross margin floor clause tied to our average unit cost (allows us to reprice if margin breaches);
  * require quarterly forecast cadence and a ramp plan in SOW tied to capacity increases.

I've highlighted those changes in the attached SOW-draft.pdf. Would like Exec sign-off or alternate guidance before we present a formal contract. Sophie requested a written proposal by EOD Monday.

Please advise — A

Thanks for the context and the clear recommendation. I approve moving forward with a conditional exec exception with the following required safeguards (must be included in the term sheet and T&Cs):

1) Discount & price lock: approve up to 30% discount for a 36-month lock provided NovaLabs signs the $1.8M committed ARR and the Exec Pricing Exception form is completed.

2) Uplift cap: reduce to 7% annual uplift (compounded).

3) Gross margin protection: include a clause allowing Redwood to trigger a market-repricing discussion if our modeled unit cost increases by >12% sustained for two consecutive quarters; negotiation limited to pricing for new consumption only (no retroactive).

4) Operational guardrails: require quarterly forecasts, onboarding milestones in the SOW, and a CS QBR cadence for the first 12 months. Cancellation/early termination fee remains as proposed.

5) Legal sign-off: Legal must vet renewal protection wording and the market-repricing trigger. Sales to confirm the final term sheet to Sophie with these conditions.

Grace — proceed to present the conditional term sheet to NovaLabs and get the Exec Pricing Exception form signed prior to DocuSign. Loop Legal and Procurement as needed. Once Sophie confirms, we can finalize DocuSign and let Finance know for revenue ops.

Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer (interim), Redwood Inference
